Planner gate runs — bump this file to start one.

run 7 — Part A1, PR #137. Run 6 reached 58 of 65 serially. The seven
that remained had three causes, all now addressed:

  - one question failed 3/3 on a 30-character cap for an INTERNAL id
    that is never shown or stored (raised to 120);
  - "is this angle just the question again?" was applied to questions
    with almost no content words, where "SB 1.2.6" and "purport to
    SB 1.2.6" score 0.75 and reach different tables. The check now
    needs at least four content words to mean anything;
  - four timeouts. This run reports PER-CALL latency separately from
    the whole stage, because the 3 s cap bounds one call and run 6's
    p95 of 3,970 ms included totals that spanned a retry. The cap will
    be set from the per-call p95 plus one second, per the brief.
